name: Policy Cards

source_identity.title: Policy Cards: Machine-Readable Runtime Governance for Autonomous AI Agents
source_identity.author: Juraj Mavračić

allowed_use_boundary: Use as external machine-readable deployment policy artifact crosswalk evidence.
Preserve Policy Cards-native terminology and framework effects.
Distinguish source-described schema/validator behavior from StegVerse simulation.
Do not treat a policy-card allow result as actor standing, StegVerse admissibility, certification, endorsement, or execution authority.
claims: The evaluated paper defines Policy Cards as versioned machine-readable deployment-layer normative policy artifacts.
The paper describes a JSON Schema 2020-12 structure with controls, obligations, monitoring, KPI/critical-auto-fail, change-management, assurance-mapping, and reference sections.
The paper describes action-rule effects allow, deny, and require_escalation and automated validation/linting integration.
non_claims: StegVerse has not executed the external full Policy Cards validator in this transition.
StegVerse has not observed a native Policy Cards runtime gateway in this transition.
The paper's statement that a public repository exists is not a verified repository/commit identity in this manifest.
Policy Cards do not prove transition admissibility.
Machine-readable policy artifacts do not automatically grant execution authority.
The wiki relationship record is not acceptance of equivalence, certification, endorsement, or compliance.

transition_table_mapping.receipt_or_trace_model: versioned card identity plus retained monitoring/evidence references
